title: Consultancy
summary: Independent advice on architecture, product and technology choices before you commit budget.
audience: Founders, product owners and business leaders weighing a build, a rebuild or a technology choice who want a senior, vendor-neutral opinion first.
deliverables: Technical discovery and current-state review
Architecture and technology recommendations with trade-offs
Build, buy or partner assessment
Written report with a prioritised roadmap and risk list
Read-out session with your team

engagement.description: A few hours a month for ongoing questions and decisions.

engagement.title: Workshop
engagement.description: One or two focused sessions on a single decision.

faq.question: Do you need access to our code?
faq.answer: For architecture or codebase reviews, yes, read-only access is enough. Strategy work can be done from documents and conversations.

faq.question: Will you recommend specific vendors or tools?
faq.answer: Only on merit. I'm not paid by any vendor, and every recommendation comes with its trade-offs.

faq.question: Can you implement the recommendations too?
faq.answer: Yes. Consultancy often leads into Software Engineering as a Service or Technical leadership, but there's no obligation.

deliverables: Production-ready features across frontend and backend
Code reviews and pull requests that follow your standards
Tests and documentation for the work delivered
Weekly progress notes and demos
A clean handover at the end of the engagement

faq.answer: Mainly TypeScript and JavaScript: Angular, React, Next.js and Node.js, with PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB on the backend.
